mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_event (aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status) VALUES (#{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{payload}::jsonb, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, last_error, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at, published_at FROM outbox_event WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW()) AND retry_count < #{maxRetries} ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = NOW(), next_retry_at = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
